correctness.rationale: The two-delay imaginary-root parametrization follows from an exact half-sum/half-difference factorization and has a reversible derivation. The equal-delay threshold follows from a scalar one-delay factorization, a transversal crossing calculation, and a strict modal-ordering proof; the stated example is independently checked by the published compact script.

originality.rationale: The 2026 source gives implicit switching equations, numerical phase regions, and explicitly leaves sharper analytical stability boundaries for future work. Searches found no source-specific prior derivation of the complete switching parametrization, exact all-N common-delay margin, or no-open-neutral-phase consequence. General DDE, CTCR, Lambert-W, and Fourier tools are not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The result supplies explicit stability-switching geometry, a sharp frequency bound, exact first-mode common-delay margin and large-ring limit, while showing that the numerically described bounded nonconvergent regime cannot be a robust open spectral phase of the linear model.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
